integrity: Analytical four-state generator proof with an independent exact-rational finite-parameter verifier; no independent mathematical audit or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies to a stationary one-dimensional harmonically trapped process with independent direction redraw and two-state correlated speed labels, finite positive speeds, and independent thermal noise; no full-density or general colored-noise classification. title: Fourth-cumulant transition invisible to covariance in a trapped Markov-speed run-and-tumble particle
